claims.text: Nematus implements an attentional encoder–decoder architecture similar to that described by Bahdanau et al., with some implementation differences.
The architecture is based on the Theano framework and is designed for high translation quality and usability.
Nematus supports various training objectives, including cross-entropy minimization and minimum risk training.
